title: dimvexa.convert/3
description: Output of `dimvexa convert --json`. Adding fields is allowed within a schema version; removing or changing them requires a new version. Exact numbers are strings so no JSON parser rounds them. /2 replaces /1: `bridge` became `density` and the always-null `profile` is gone (ADR-014). /3 (ADR-018): exact numbers may carry a power of ten and a power of pi (`1/2 pi`), and `exact.decimal` is new.

value.description: Decimal expansion of the exact result, at most 15 fraction digits. For a value with pi (no finite expansion), or a power of ten that does not fit the fraction, it is the result rounded once to the nearest f64, written as the shortest decimal that reads back to it (it may use exponent form, such as 1.7453292519943296e-22), and `truncated` is true.

f64.description: The exact result rounded once to the nearest f64.

truncated.description: True if value was cut at 15 fraction digits, or if the exact result has a power of pi or a power of ten that does not fit the fraction and value is its rounded decimal.

value.description: Exact value as `num/den`, or with a power of ten and/or pi after the fraction when the value has one (ADR-018): `1/2 pi`, `pi`, `180 pi^-1`, `1602176634 10^-28`. A coefficient of 1 is left out beside a factor. A power of ten that fits the fraction is multiplied in.

decimal.description: The exact value rounded once to the nearest f64, as the shortest decimal that reads back to it (for example 1.5707963267948966 for 1/2 pi).

factor.description: Exact value as `num/den`, or with a power of ten and/or pi after the fraction when the value has one (ADR-018): `1/2 pi`, `pi`, `180 pi^-1`, `1602176634 10^-28`. A coefficient of 1 is left out beside a factor. A power of ten that fits the fraction is multiplied in.

offset.description: Exact offset b in y = a * x + b; always a plain fraction.

dimension.description: Exponents of kg, m, s, A, K, mol, cd.

kind.description: Conversion shape (named `kind` in the plan's sketch; see quantity_kind for the quantity kind).

config.description: The configs applied with --config, in order (empty if none): the file as given, or `bundled:NAME` for a config that ships with dimvexa, and a content hash (fnv1a64), so a result can be reproduced.

density.description: The density the conversion went through (ADR-014), or null. A density is used only when requested with --density and only when the plain conversion is refused (mass <-> volume needs a density). The result's exactness is then `measured`, and the density's source is also listed in `sources`. A number written on the command line (`--density 998.2067kg/m3`) has file `--density` and line 0.

code.description: Library error codes (stable, non-exhaustive list) plus `usage` for command-line mistakes.

candidates.description: Explicit symbols or close matches (ambiguous_symbol, unknown_unit).

suggestions.description: Everything the error recommends instead: candidates, or the delta unit (delta_K, delta_degC, ...) for temperature kind errors and refused offset units.
